title: Food Poisoning
immediate_warning: Call 112 if the person is severely dehydrated, has bloody diarrhoea, is unconscious, or cannot keep fluids down for 8 hours.

description: Food poisoning is caused by eating contaminated food. Most cases resolve within 1–3 days with rest and fluids.

description_translations.en: Food poisoning is caused by eating contaminated food. Most cases resolve within 1–3 days with rest and fluids.
description_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Food poisoning is caused by eating contaminated food. Most cases resolve within 1–3 days with rest and fluids.

description_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Food poisoning is caused by eating contaminated food. Most cases resolve within 1–3 days with rest and fluids.

steps.instruction: Have the person rest and drink plenty of fluids — water, oral rehydration salts (ORS), or weak tea.

instruction_translations.en: Have the person rest and drink plenty of fluids — water, oral rehydration salts (ORS), or weak tea.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Have the person rest and drink plenty of fluids — water, oral rehydration salts (ORS), or weak tea.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Have the person rest and drink plenty of fluids — water, oral rehydration salts (ORS), or weak tea.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Have the person rest and drink plenty of fluids — water, oral rehydration salts (ORS), or weak tea.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Have the person rest and drink plenty of fluids — water, oral rehydration salts (ORS), or weak tea.

steps.instruction: Give ORS sachets mixed in clean water to replace lost fluids and electrolytes.

instruction_translations.en: Give ORS sachets mixed in clean water to replace lost fluids and electrolytes.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Give ORS sachets mixed in clean water to replace lost fluids and electrolytes.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Give ORS sachets mixed in clean water to replace lost fluids and electrolytes.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Give ORS sachets mixed in clean water to replace lost fluids and electrolytes.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Give ORS sachets mixed in clean water to replace lost fluids and electrolytes.

steps.instruction: Avoid solid food until vomiting stops. Then start with bland food like plain rice or bread.

instruction_translations.en: Avoid solid food until vomiting stops. Then start with bland food like plain rice or bread.

instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Avoid solid food until vomiting stops. Then start with bland food like plain rice or bread.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Avoid solid food until vomiting stops. Then start with bland food like plain rice or bread.

steps.instruction: Monitor for signs of severe dehydration: very dry mouth, sunken eyes, little or no urine.

instruction_translations.en: Monitor for signs of severe dehydration: very dry mouth, sunken eyes, little or no urine.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Monitor for signs of severe dehydration: very dry mouth, sunken eyes, little or no urine.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Monitor for signs of severe dehydration: very dry mouth, sunken eyes, little or no urine.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Monitor for signs of severe dehydration: very dry mouth, sunken eyes, little or no urine.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Monitor for signs of severe dehydration: very dry mouth, sunken eyes, little or no urine.

steps.instruction: Seek hospital care if symptoms worsen after 24 hours or severe dehydration occurs.

instruction_translations.en: Seek hospital care if symptoms worsen after 24 hours or severe dehydration occurs.

instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Seek hospital care if symptoms worsen after 24 hours or severe dehydration occurs.

do_not: Do not give anti-diarrhoea medication unless advised by a doctor.
Do not ignore bloody stool or high fever.
